scope: 1214fr (protocol 80, #134, #135): 1214fq plus partner gameflow advances and the join placement. The gameflow mirror set every differing partner node back to the host state, so an objective the partner completed in its own world was reverted (route-dunwall-lead-v1665b); a partner advance of a node the host has non-zero is now held against the mirror for 10 s and reported (D2GA), and the host applies it natively when its node still has the reported state. A partner whose game followed the host into a mission is placed 1.2 m behind the host with setviewpos once both worlds are in gameplay there, when it is 25 m or more away (route-dunwall-join-v1666b: 27.5 m). Unit tests cover the advance rule and the placement.
